convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load VortexIndicator (custom indicator) and includes TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for trade execution logic

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before calculation
TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade timing

other_exits: Opposite Vortex crossover closes existing position: DnValue>UpValue closes long, UpValue>DnValue closes short

position_sizing.conditional_logic: negative MM value = fixed lot size (abs value), positive MM value = fraction of deposit

custom_logic_notes: Entry signal requires two-bar confirmation: UpValue[1]>DnValue[1] (current crossover state on completed bar) AND UpValue[0]<=DnValue[0] (previous bar was opposite direction, confirming fresh crossover). SignalBar=1 means signals are read from bar index 1 (last completed bar). The BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input booleans act as permission gates allowing selective enabling/disabling of each trade direction and exit type. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime are computed from SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec and passed to trade functions likely to prevent duplicate entries within the same bar period.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementation of VortexIndicator (VI+ and VI- lines) since it is a custom indicator loaded via iCustom. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory) must all be reimplemented in Python. Position sizing logic is conditional: negative MM = fixed lots, positive MM = deposit fraction - must handle both branches. The crossover detection uses a two-bar lookback pattern (bar[1] crossed above, bar[0] was below or equal) which is a standard crossover confirmation check. SL/TP values are in points (not pips), so Python conversion must clarify whether the broker uses 4-digit or 5-digit pricing to determine if 1000 points = 100 pips (5-digit) or 1000 pips (4-digit). No digit adjustment is present in the code itself.
